_comment: The games on the Arcade. build.js turns each entry into a card, so adding
a game is a change to this file and nothing else - no HTML to edit.
kind     the small line under the name
url      where it lives. Somebody else's game points at their own site.
desc     a sentence or three. Plain text; the build escapes it.
Describe the game, not its contents. A count ("five cars") goes
stale the next time somebody adds one, and nothing tells the hub.
pills    up to three short tags
accent   the top border and the Play colour
art      optional: src/art/<art>.svg. Left out, the build draws a
lettermark from the name, which is a perfectly good card.
tile     optional background behind the art
The build refuses anything it cannot vouch for: a url that is not http or
https, a colour that is not a plain hex value. All text is escaped on the
way in. That matters because some of this arrives from other people.

games.name: Top Shelf
games.desc: Five a side on ice, four on roller. Career mode with cards, packs, custom sticks and a season. Play the CPU, a friend on the same screen, or manage from the bench.

games.name: Side Pot
games.desc: Play-money No-Limit Hold’em with your friends. One person hosts the table in their own browser and everyone else connects straight to it — the cards go peer to peer, with no server in the middle.

games.name: Big Turbos
games.desc: A garage where every expensive part is a trade — aero costs you top speed, short gears run out of road, nitrous is weight you carry whether you press it or not. Race the championships, run the quarter mile, or just drive around the map.
